items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

items.title: Long before AI builds a robot, it's going to design the parts, and OpenAI just showed how far along that already is. On
items.summary:
Long before AI builds a robot, it's going to design the parts, and OpenAI just showed how far along that already is. On November 3 the company said model usage across its hardware team has grown 23-fold since February.

Two engineers used GPT-6 Astra to design a working Codex-connected device in under a week, and a contract manufacturer built prototypes in under a month.

A newer internal model scored 0.875 on BenchCAD 2.0, against 0.594 for GPT-6 Astra (an internal, company-reported benchmark). OpenAI is also working with Chip Ganassi Racing on converting 3D scans into CAD models, and with Mazda on aerodynamics and crash-safety simulation.

When the gap between an idea and an engineered object shrinks to a week, the scarce skill becomes taste, meaning knowing what's worth building at all.

I see that as part of the human-agency story as much as the automation story, because the person deciding what to make matters more as the making gets easier.

If design is about to get this cheap, the useful thing to sharpen now is your judgment about which problems deserve a physical product.

items.summary:
In March 2026, Oracle and OpenAI reportedly dropped plans to expand Stargate in Abilene, Texas, from about 1.2 GW toward 2 GW. Oracle called the coverage false and incorrect.

What disappeared was the next 800 MW, and the contract that would have paid for the power behind it.
